name: Ticket neighborhood
when: User asks who or what is connected to tickets (queue, assignee, resolver, SLA, notes).
not_when: User wants a certified KPI number. That is sql ticket_count or another KPI.

name: Why breakdown
when: User asks why volume moved, what drove a set, or split along queue/agent/category/priority/channel/status.
not_when: User only wants a single certified rate or count with no driver split.

name: Assignment path
when: User asks how tickets sit on queues and assignees as a path.

name: Queue staffing
when: User asks which agents staff a queue, or who staffs the queues with no queue named.

name: Note path
when: User asks notes on tickets and who wrote them as a graph path. Note volume as a KPI is sql note_count.

name: Customer path
when: User asks which contact raised tickets or Contact HAS TicketHistory.
